sharedMemories.text: Hello, my name is Khai, and I am a first-year university student majoring in Information Technology. I am particularly interested in embedded systems because I want to become an embedded systems engineer in the future. I attend classes regularly and enjoy learning about computers and technology. In my free time, I often study English to improve my communication skills. I am also preparing for the Aptis exam because I want to achieve a good result. Besides studying, I enjoy cooking meals for my family. Although learning English can be challenging, I believe it will help me in my future career.
